metadata.description: High-signal individual voices on social platforms
metadata.note: These are people, not publications - following individual thinkers rather than editorial boards

high_signal_accounts.name: Andrej Karpathy
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Ex-OpenAI, Tesla. Best educator in AI. Clear technical explanations without hype.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Thread reader often needed for long-form thoughts

high_signal_accounts.name: Simon Willison
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Deep practical knowledge, excellent at explaining complex topics simply
high_signal_accounts.notes: Also has excellent blog at simonwillison.net

high_signal_accounts.name: Yann LeCun
high_signal_accounts.focus: AI research, Meta AI, deep learning
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Meta Chief Scientist. Research perspective, often contrarian to hype
high_signal_accounts.notes: Can be argumentative but signals are high

high_signal_accounts.name: Jeremy Howard
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: fast.ai founder. Makes ML accessible, focuses on practical application
high_signal_accounts.notes: Often shares notebooks and working code

high_signal_accounts.name: Dan Luu
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Extremely rigorous analysis of systems performance. Data-driven contrarian takes.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Blog posts are deep dives; tweets are signals worth tracking

high_signal_accounts.name: Patrick McKenzie
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Unique perspective on intersection of tech and business. Long-form tweet threads.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Works at Stripe; insights on financial infrastructure

high_signal_accounts.name: Jessie Frazelle
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Deep systems knowledge, early Docker contributor, practical insights
high_signal_accounts.notes: Now at Oxide Computer; hardware + software perspective

high_signal_accounts.name: John Carmack
high_signal_accounts.why_follow: Legendary engineer. Still coding daily. Unique insights on AGI from ML research.
high_signal_accounts.notes: Now full-time AGI research; shares research process openly

selection_criteria: Shares working code/artifacts, not just opinions

integration_notes.workaround: Use Nitter RSS feeds with fallback to manual curation
integration_notes.priority: Medium - these are highest signal but hardest to automate
integration_notes.alternative: Monitor their blogs when available (Simon Willison, Dan Luu have RSS)
